snippet.description:

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Unacademy Current Affairs Bilingual Course : https://unacademy.com/store/batch/unacademy-current-affairs-bilingual/DDSF8PIC
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1. ₹16,999 for 14 Months of India's Best UPSC Prep. 
🚀 Join Now: https://unacademy.com/goal/upsc-civil-services-examination-ias-preparation/KSCGY/subscribe?plan_type=plus&referral_code=WORLDAFFAIRS
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
India’s own GPS is back. On the night of 30 October, ISRO’s GSLV-F18 launched the NVS-03 satellite from Sriharikota. ISRO says this restores NavIC, India’s own navigation system, to its minimum working strength of four satellites. NavIC had fallen to three working satellites in March 2026, after the last atomic clock on IRNSS-1F failed. The previous replacement, NVS-02, got stuck in orbit in January 2025 because a valve did not open. This time, ISRO reportedly flew the satellite with its valves already open so the same failure could not happen twice.

Why does this matter? NavIC was born from the Kargil War of 1999, when India’s request for US GPS data was widely reported to have been refused. A system that India controls is one no foreign government can switch off in a war.

In this video, Kinjal Choudhary explains:

What happened on launch night: GSLV-F18, NVS-03 and the 18-minute flight
How NavIC fell to just 3 satellites in 2026
The stuck valve that stranded NVS-02, and ISRO’s unusual fix
Why NavIC exists: from Kargil 1999 to Operation Sindoor
Is NavIC harder to jam and spoof than GPS?
Why atomic clocks are the hard part, and India’s indigenous clock
“One Nation, One Time”: how NavIC now backs India’s official time
What the L1 signal means for your smartphone
What’s next: NVS-04, NVS-05 and the 7-satellite target

Note: NavIC is at its minimum operational configuration, not full strength. NVS-03 still has to raise itself to its final slot at 32.5° East.

Presented by Kinjal Choudhary

snippet.title: Трактор Т-16: почему его звали официантом
snippet.description:
Трактор Т-16 носит свой груз перед собой, как официант поднос. Так его и прозвали в колхозах — официант.

Кузов у самоходного шасси стоит прямо перед кабиной, а двигатель за спиной тракториста. Мотор у Т-16М всего на 25 лошадиных сил. Зато в коробке 7 передач вперёд и ходоуменьшитель, а на крюке он тянет до 700 килограммов.

Под тяжестью полного кузова маленькие передние колёса зарываются в грязь. Толкают машину большие задние — на 32-дюймовых дисках.

Т-16М выпускали в Харькове с 1967 по 1995 год. А в 1982 году на шасси Т-16 поставили даже авиационный реактивный двигатель: струя горячих газов плавила лёд и снег.

snippet.title: When Fighter Jets Escorted Food Supplies Over Enemy Skies ✈️🔥 #OperationPoomalai #IAF #History
snippet.description:
In June 1987, India tried to send relief by sea to the Jaffna peninsula in Sri Lanka. Sri Lanka's navy turned the boats back. The next day, the Indian Air Force flew the aid in, with fighter escorts. This was Operation Poomalai.

- The setting: in late May 1987 Sri Lanka's army launched an offensive on the Jaffna peninsula, held by Tamil rebels. Indian officials said Jaffna's people had lived under an economic blockade for five months. Press estimates put Jaffna's population at around 900,000.
- 2 June: India announced an unarmed relief convoy through the Indian Red Cross. Colombo called it "a clear infringement of our sovereignty that we will have to oppose".
- 3 June: the boats sailed under the Red Cross flag. Sri Lanka's navy refused them entry to its waters, and they turned back.
- 4 June: India summoned Sri Lanka's High Commissioner in Delhi. He was told that aircraft were on their way and that any resistance would be met by force.
- Operation Poomalai: five IAF An-32 transports took off from Bangalore. Four Mirage 2000 fighters of No. 7 Squadron joined them before they entered Sri Lankan airspace, and the An-32s air-dropped relief supplies over the Jaffna peninsula. "Poomalai" is Tamil for "flower garland".
- After: Colombo called it a violation of its sovereignty and protested to the UN. On 29 July 1987, eight weeks later, India and Sri Lanka signed the Indo-Sri Lanka Accord.

Notes:
- Sources give the tonnage as 22, about 24 and about 25 tonnes, so the video says "more than 20 tonnes".
- Sources differ on the day and the details of the boat convoy. The video follows the 3 June date and gives no boat count.
- Wikipedia's article gives five Mirages in one place and four in another. The video follows Bharat Rakshak: four.
- The routes, the boats' turn-back point and the drawn aircraft are illustrations, not footage. The satellite imagery is from today.

localized.title: When Fighter Jets Escorted Food Supplies Over Enemy Skies ✈️🔥 #OperationPoomalai #IAF #History
localized.description:
In June 1987, India tried to send relief by sea to the Jaffna peninsula in Sri Lanka. Sri Lanka's navy turned the boats back. The next day, the Indian Air Force flew the aid in, with fighter escorts. This was Operation Poomalai.

- The setting: in late May 1987 Sri Lanka's army launched an offensive on the Jaffna peninsula, held by Tamil rebels. Indian officials said Jaffna's people had lived under an economic blockade for five months. Press estimates put Jaffna's population at around 900,000.
- 2 June: India announced an unarmed relief convoy through the Indian Red Cross. Colombo called it "a clear infringement of our sovereignty that we will have to oppose".
- 3 June: the boats sailed under the Red Cross flag. Sri Lanka's navy refused them entry to its waters, and they turned back.
- 4 June: India summoned Sri Lanka's High Commissioner in Delhi. He was told that aircraft were on their way and that any resistance would be met by force.
- Operation Poomalai: five IAF An-32 transports took off from Bangalore. Four Mirage 2000 fighters of No. 7 Squadron joined them before they entered Sri Lankan airspace, and the An-32s air-dropped relief supplies over the Jaffna peninsula. "Poomalai" is Tamil for "flower garland".
- After: Colombo called it a violation of its sovereignty and protested to the UN. On 29 July 1987, eight weeks later, India and Sri Lanka signed the Indo-Sri Lanka Accord.

Notes:
- Sources give the tonnage as 22, about 24 and about 25 tonnes, so the video says "more than 20 tonnes".
- Sources differ on the day and the details of the boat convoy. The video follows the 3 June date and gives no boat count.
- Wikipedia's article gives five Mirages in one place and four in another. The video follows Bharat Rakshak: four.
- The routes, the boats' turn-back point and the drawn aircraft are illustrations, not footage. The satellite imagery is from today.

snippet.description:
Crude Oil నుంచి Petrol ఎలా తయారవుతుంది? 🤯 Refinery Explained
Russia నుంచి Vizag Petrol Bunk వరకు Petrol ప్రయాణం! 😲


Mee bike tank loki vachche petrol, lakshala ella kritham samudram aduguna modhalaina prayaanam! Ee 3D animation lo crude oil ela puttindhi, ela bayataki theestharu, refinery lo petrol ga ela maaruthundhi, mee petrol bunk ki ela cheruthundhi choodandi: how petrol is made, step by step, in Telugu.

Samudram lo sookshmajeevula avasheshaalu aduguna cheri, vaati meedha matti poralu perigi bhoomi lopaliki kurukupoyayi. Lakshala samvathsaraala vedi, otthidi tho avi crude oil ga maarayi. Russia lo oil wells dwaara crude ni bayataki theesi, gas, water separate chesi, pipeline dwaara Kozmino port ki pampistharu. Tanker ship South China Sea, Singapore daggara Malacca Strait, Bay of Bengal dwaara Vizag coast ki vasthundhi. Refinery lo water, salts thagginchi furnace lo heat chesi, distillation tower lo light gases, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, heavy oil ga separate chestharu. Naphtha ni hydrogen tho treat chesi sulphur thaggisthaaru, reforming tho quality penchutharu; heavy oil ni cracking units lo vidagotti marinni petrol components thayaaru chestharu. Blend chesi quality test chesaaka, distribution terminal lo 80 shaatham petrol ki 20 shaatham ethanol kalipi E20 fuel chesi, road tanker lo petrol bunk ki pampistharu.

Ee video lo nerchukune topics: crude oil formation, oil wells, oil-gas-water separation, ESPO pipeline, crude oil tanker route, Malacca Strait, oil refinery process, desalting, crude distillation unit, fractional distillation, naphtha hydrotreating, catalytic reforming, FCC cracking, petrol blending, E20 ethanol blended petrol, fuel distribution terminal, petrol bunk underground tank.

snippet.title: The Mang Tomas sauce is named after a real man. His family doesn't make it.
snippet.description:
The Mang Tomas sauce on your lechon is named after a real Filipino man. 🇵🇭

"Mang" is a respectful way to call an older man, so Mang Tomas means Mr. Tomas. Tomas de los Reyes sold pork near a cockpit in La Loma, Quezon City. His daughter-in-law says it was 1950. Other sources give anywhere from 1949 to 1954.

The word lechon comes from Spanish, for a suckling pig. In Manila, it comes with a dark liver sauce for dipping. In Cebu, people say lechon needs no sauce at all.

The bottle you can buy in American stores is labeled "All Purpose Sauce." Since 1991, a big food company has owned the brand. But the family's own stall is still on that street, and when Manila Bulletin visited in 2020, his daughter-in-law Cora spoke for them.

She said they would keep on roasting lechon "until it passes to the grandchildren."

Every third Sunday of May, La Loma holds a lechon festival. In 2026, the city honored Tomas de los Reyes.

His name is on the bottle. His family kept the fire.

Sources: Manila Bulletin, Quezon City Government, Mang Tomas ad (1998) and others →

snippet.title: 아무 말 없던 119 전화, 수화기 너머 숨소리의 정체
snippet.description:
지난 25일 저녁 6시 50분쯤, 세종소방본부 119종합상황실에 신고 전화 한 통이 걸려 왔지만 수화기 너머에서는 아무 말도 들리지 않았습니다.

전화를 받은 상황실 소방관은 단순히 잘못 걸린 전화로 여기지 않고 통화를 이어 가다 희미한 숨소리를 들었습니다. 신고자는 말을 할 수 없는 상태였고 휴대전화 위치 정보도 꺼져 있었습니다. 소방관은 휴대전화 접속 기록으로 기지국을 조회해 대략적인 위치를 파악하고, 마을 이장에게도 수소문했지만 아는 사람이 없었습니다. 통화가 끊길 때마다 다시 전화를 걸어 신고자의 상태를 확인했고, 함께 근무하던 경찰 협력관이 같은 번호로 112에 신고한 이력을 찾아내면서 주소를 특정할 수 있었습니다.

구급대는 신고 30분이 채 안 돼 세종 연서면의 한 주택에 도착했고, 말투가 어눌하고 어지러움을 호소하던 60대 신고자를 응급처치한 뒤 병원으로 옮겼습니다. 세종소방본부는 위급한 상황에서 말을 하기 어렵더라도 119 전화를 끊지 않고 통화를 유지하면 구조에 큰 도움이 된다고 당부했습니다.

From emerging clean energy technologies to investment opportunities, industry challenges and the future of green jobs, there's plenty to explore.

Team gen.E will be there to uncover what's changing, what's possible, and what's next for India's clean energy future.

📢 4주년 기념 특별 옥외 광고 [MARIAN: WHITE & BLACK IN 용산] 사전 안내
​
✔️ 진행 기간

✔️ 옥외 광고 주요 전시존 안내
- 이번 4주년 기념 옥외 광고는 대형 공기 조형물, 계단 랩핑 광고, 벽화, 미니 포토존, 대형 트릭아트와 미니 트릭아트로 구성됩니다.
현장에서는 미니 트릭아트 라이브 드로잉과 카운터스 스쿼드 3인방의 인형탈 그리팅 등 특별 이벤트도 진행됩니다.
 
▪ 마리안 : 퀸의 초대형 공기 조형물 (4층 더 테라스)

「MARIAN: WHITE & BLACK IN 용산」은 아이파크몰 용산점에 들어서기 전부터 시작됩니다.
 
아이파크몰 용산점에 도착해 1층 광장으로 들어서면, 잠시 고개를 들어 보세요.
 4층 더 [테라스]에 우뚝 선 마리안 : 퀸의 거대한 공기 조형물이 멀리서도 눈에 띌 것입니다.
​
그중에서도 마리안의 조형물을 감상하기 가장 좋은 곳은 맞은편 용산역 앞 잔디광장입니다.
​
조형물의 전체 모습을 한눈에 담을 수 있으니, 
기념사진을 찍고 싶으시다면 용산역 앞 잔디광장을 방문해 보세요.

​
▪ 1층 광장 [더 스테어]

조형물을 올려다본 뒤 시선을 아래로 돌리면, 
이번에는 또 하나의 4주년 기념 아트를 만나실 수 있습니다.
 
바로 아이파크몰 용산점 1층 광장의 대계단을 장식한 계단 랩핑 광고입니다.
​
인류의 운명을 건 대전을 앞둔 마리안 : 퀸과 갓데스 스쿼드, 
그리고 그들 앞을 가로막은 릴리바이스 퀸.
​
이들의 대치 장면을 대계단 전체에 재현했습니다. 
광장에 들어서는 순간, 눈앞에 펼쳐지는 4주년 기념 아트를 만나 보세요.
 
※ 이외에도 아이파크몰 용산점 곳곳에서 [승리의 여신: 니케]의 다양한 옥외 광고를 만나 보실 수 있습니다. 이동 중에도 광고를 찾아보세요.
※ 단, 에스컬레이터를 이용하실 때는 반드시 안전에 유의해 주시기 바랍니다.
 
계단 아트를 감상하셨다면 에스컬레이터를 타고 4층으로 올라가 주세요. 
그곳에서는 마리안이 기다리는 특별한 정원이 펼쳐집니다.
 
▪ 4층 [더 가든]
지휘관님과의 추억을 간직한 마리안의 아름다운 모습을
초대형 벽화로 만나 보실 수 있습니다. 
​
그 앞 정원에는 새하얀 드레스를 입고 지휘관님을 향해 손을 흔드는 
마리안의 대형 공기 조형물이 기다리고 있습니다.

또한 [더 가든]에는 미니 포토존도 마련되어 있습니다.
포토존에 장식된 꽃들은 모두 마리안이 지휘관님을 생각하며 직접 고른 것입니다.
 
"오늘 이 순간, 오래오래 기억하고 싶거든요."
​
지휘관님과의 행복한 순간을 영원히 간직하고 싶었던
마리안의 마음이 담긴 이곳에서 특별한 기념사진을 남겨 보세요.
 
[더 가든]에서 기념사진을 찍으셨다면, 이제 [더 테라스]로 발걸음을 옮겨 주세요.
 
▪ 4층 [더 테라스]
앞서 멀리서 올려다보셨던 마리안 : 퀸의 대형 공기 조형물이
바로 이곳 [더 테라스]에 자리하고 있습니다.
​
그리고 그 아래에는 게임 속 전장을 현실에 재현한
초대형 트릭아트 존이 마련되어 있습니다.
​
바닥을 가득 채운 트릭아트 위에 올라서면,

snippet.title: 태국에서 코코넛 팬케이크를 주문하면 생기는 일
snippet.description:
태국의 미니 코코넛 팬케이크, 카놈크록입니다. 

여긴 판단이라는 초록색 잎을 넣어서 반죽에 향을 더하는데요🌿 얇게 눌러 구워서 겉이 바삭하고 속은 촉촉해요. 은은한 판단 향과 코코넛의 적당한 달콤함, 고소함이 좋았고, 어린 코코넛 과육과 팥 토핑도 잘 어울렸어요🥥

📍[ช้อนเงิน Silver Spoon]
- 위치: 태국 논타부리, NONTSTOP 시장 내 A61
- 영업: 10:00–22:00 (시장 운영시간)
- 메뉴: 판단 코코넛 카놈크록 8개 (35바트)

Pressed thin as they cook, the pancakes become crispy outside while staying soft and moist inside. I loved the subtle pandan aroma and the coconut’s gentle sweetness and nutty richness. The young coconut and red bean toppings paired beautifully, too🥥

📍[ช้อนเงิน Silver Spoon]
- Location: Stall A61, NONTSTOP Market, Nonthaburi, Thailand
- Hours: 10:00–22:00 (market hours)
- Menu: Pandan Coconut Khanom Krok — 8 pieces for 35 THB
